description: What to do if your child or a minor in your care has been arrested.

steps.text: Stay calm and go to the station where they are held.
Ask on what grounds the child is held (s.35(3)); they are presumed innocent (s.36(5)).
Insist that the child not be questioned or made to sign anything without a lawyer and a parent or guardian.
The child has a right to dignity and must not be beaten or degraded (s.34(1)).
Ask about release on bail; police bail is free.
Note the officers' names, numbers, and the time.
Call a lawyer or Legal Aid immediately.
